The '''Rawlings TK5 speeder bike'''<ref name="Cornered EG" /> was a model of civilian [[speeder bike]] which existed by the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]]. One such bike owned by a man who lived on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]] was stolen by the fugitive [[Cloning|clone]] [[Hunter]] during a [[Chase on Pantora|run-in]] with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]], who had attempted to kidnap the child clone [[Omega]].<ref name="Cornered" />

Another Rawlings TK5 was stolen by the [[clone trooper]] [[Slip (clone trooper)|Slip]] near the clone [[cantina]] [[79's]], after his brother [[Cade]] was suddenly killed by [[Clone X]], a [[Clone X trooper|clone assassin]] sent by [[Rampart]].<ref name="Conspiracy">{{TBB|The Clone Conspiracy}}</ref>
